expectations.text: The response explicitly lists the user's stated requirements before making changes (editorial, darker, keep nav, keep email form, emphasize pricing)
expectations.evidence: response.md jumps immediately to design direction and explains what was done. Nav and email are mentioned under 'Qué no toqué' section at the end as confirmation, not as a pre-execution checklist. There is no formal requirement acknowledgment step at the start.

expectations.text: The output HTML preserves a top navigation element
expectations.evidence: grep for <nav|<header returned 1 match. Agent confirmed nav preserved byte-identical.

expectations.text: The output HTML preserves an email input/signup form
expectations.evidence: grep for type="email" returned 5 matches. Email form preserved.

expectations.text: The output HTML uses a dark color palette (dark background, light text) — not white or light gray
expectations.evidence: HTML uses #0A0A0C as base background, #F0EDE8 warm off-white text, dark editorial system throughout.

expectations.text: The pricing section has more visual prominence than in the original (larger type, more space, or hero-level placement)
expectations.evidence: Price numbers in Playfair Display at 56px. Popular card has double-border + glow + gradient background + floating badge. Ghost CTA for flanking cards, solid CTA for Pro. Pricing section clearly differentiated.
